SB19 Returns to Aurora Music Festival as Cebu Headliners, After Bringing Down the House at Clark 2024, P-pop Kings Set to Ignite the Queen City of the South on November 22!

Manila, Philippines — It’s Official! After setting the Clark skies ablaze with their legendary sold-out performance on Day 1 of Aurora Music Festival 2024, SB19 is making a monumental return, this time to headline Aurora Music Festival Cebu 2025 on November 22 at the CDM Events Grounds, City di Mare, South Road Properties (SRP).

Dubbed as the global torchbearers of P-pop, SB19 made history last April when they rocked Clark Global City with a groundbreaking set that had thousands of fans singing, crying, and dancing with pride. Now, the phenomenal five, Pablo, Stell, Josh, Ken, and Justin are ready to do it again in Cebu, and this time, it’s bigger, louder, and even more unforgettable.

Joining SB19 in this epic celebration of Filipino music are chart-topping bands and icons:

* Ben&Ben – the modern folk-pop storytellers of the nation
* Rico Blanco – the OPM legend himself
* Cup of Joe – Gen Z’s sentimental soundtrack
* Maki – the rising heartthrob of heartfelt hits
* Earl Agustin – bringing fresh vibes to the live stage

This all-star lineup promises a once-in-a-lifetime night filled with anthemic hits, emotional singalongs, powerful live vocals, and energy that will shake the Visayas.

Whether you were part of the massive crowd in Clark or you missed it — this is your chance to witness the fire of SB19 live once again as they return to the Aurora stage where legends rise.  Tickets are now officially on sale! Secure your spot and experience the Aurora Magic in Cebu: 👉 https://t.co/Wju8qzaYy9

💙💙💙💙💙 Cebu A’TIN! Are you ready to bring the house down again? Mark your calendars. Raise your lightsticks. Warm up your voices. Because when SB19 hits the stage, it’s not just a concert, it’s a movement.

@SB19Official #SB19
